page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, alongside 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.g7t.2xlarge in the average performance tier for most compute and processing tasks. The instance achieves a single-core stress-ng CPU score of 1848.29 and a multi-core score of 7761.62, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 5386.0. While cached small-block memory bandwidth is strong at 426.71 GB/sec, large-block uncached read and write memory bandwidths drop to 23.86 GB/sec and 23.08 GB/sec respectively, which are categorized as weak. This memory performance bottleneck is also reflected in a lower PassMark memory score.

The instance is suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, where it achieves a throughput of 11.32 GB/sec, and database operations, processing 7.95 million Redis SET operations per second. However, it is poorly suited for larger artificial intelligence tasks; LLM inference speeds for a medium 7B model are poor, yielding only 5.92 tokens per second for text generation. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource profile, it represents a stable option for standard application servers, software compilation, and moderate database workloads, though memory-intensive large-dataset operations may experience performance limitations.
